summary_en: KU HD executed a block purchase of 500,000 shares (1.58% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 1,169 yen per share on November 16, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 584.5 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: KU HD announced the execution of a block share repurchase under its authorized buyback program on November 16, 2026. The company purchased 500,000 shares (1.58% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at a fixed price of 1,169 yen per share through ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading, with a total outlay of 584.5 million yen. This execution represents a portion of the broader 10 million share authorization (3.16% of shares outstanding) approved for the period from November 16 to December 30, 2026, for which the company set a maximum aggregate consideration of 1.3 billion yen and may purchase shares through either market purchases or additional off-hours block trades.
